import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';
import 'client.dart';
import 'types.dart';

void main() {
 test('closed generic types retain nested and nullable selections', () async {
  final driver=Platform.environment['LUXO_GENERIC_HTTP_CONSUMER'];
  final capture=Platform.environment['LUXO_GENERIC_CAPTURE'];
  final scratch=Directory('.tmp')..createSync(recursive:true);
  final own=scratch.createTempSync('generic-go-');
  addTearDown(() { own.deleteSync(recursive:true); });
  var sent=0;
  for(final mode in driver==null?[TransportMode.json]:[TransportMode.json,TransportMode.binary]) {
   final transport=HttpTransport('http://generic.fixture.invalid',options:TransportOptions(mode:mode),client:MockClient((request) async {
    sent++;
    final input=mode==TransportMode.json
     ? {'mode':'json','request':jsonDecode(request.body)}
     : {'mode':'binary','bytes':request.bodyBytes.toList()};
    if(driver==null) {
     final body=input['request'] as Map<String,dynamic>;
     final data=switch(body[r'$api']) {
      'readPage'=>{'items':[{'value':{'value':42}}],'total':1,'page':1,'pageSize':20},
      'readCursor'=>{'items':[{'value':{'value':43}}],'nextCursor':'next','hasMore':true},
      _=>body['value'],
     };
     return http.Response(jsonEncode({'data':data}),200);
    }
    final file=File('${own.path}/request.jsonl')..writeAsStringSync('${jsonEncode(input)}\n');
    final process=await Process.run(driver,[file.absolute.path]);
    expect(process.exitCode,0,reason:process.stderr.toString());
    final response=jsonDecode(process.stdout.toString()) as Map<String,dynamic>;
    if(capture!=null) File(capture).writeAsStringSync('${jsonEncode({'request':input,'response':response})}\n',mode:FileMode.append);
    expect(response['status'],200,reason:response.toString());
    return mode==TransportMode.json
     ? http.Response(jsonEncode(response['json']),200)
     : http.Response.bytes((response['bytes'] as List).cast<int>(),200);
   }));
   final client=LuxoClient(transport);
   try {
    final page=await client.readPage();
    expect(page.items.value.first.value.value.value.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(42));
    expect(page.total.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
    expect(page.page.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(1));
    expect(page.pageSize.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(20));
    final cursor=await client.readCursor();
    expect(cursor.items.value.first.value.value.value.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(43));
    expect(cursor.nextCursor.value,'next');
    expect(cursor.hasMore.value,isTrue);
    final nested=await client.echoNested(value:LuxoBox_d1dc0a950b2f5e29Input(value:LuxoPage_5411031e24da9aefInput(
     items:[CounterInput(value:LuxoInt64.fromInt(44))],total:LuxoInt64.fromInt(1),page:LuxoInt64.fromInt(1),pageSize:LuxoInt64.fromInt(20))));
    expect(nested.value.value.items.value.first.value.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(44));
    final values=await client.echoLists(value:[LuxoBox_847cd3e6a7855432Input(value:null),LuxoBox_847cd3e6a7855432Input(value:LuxoInt64.fromInt(45))]);
    expect(values.first.value.value==null,isTrue);
    expect(values.last.value.value, LuxoInt64.fromInt(45));
   } finally { client.close(); }
  }
  expect(sent,driver==null?4:8);
 });
}
